'''Pandora's Box''' is a {{Common}} [[Accessories|Accessory]] obtained from [[Shen's Auction]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Shen's Auction ===
The '''Pandora's Box''' appears in [[Shen's Auction]], and can be won if the player is one of the top {{Green|20}} bidders on the item when the auction ends. {{Gamemode|Ironman}} profiles have a separate auction, where top {{Green|10}} bidders get the item.
When {{NPCSprite|Mayor Diaz|alt=Mayor Diaz}} is elected with the Volume trading perk, the quantity is doubled to {{Green|40}} top bids ({{Green|20}} for {{Gamemode|Ironman}}).

=== Raffle of the Century ===
A '''Pandora's Box''' can also be obtained as a {{Red|'''MAJOR'''}} reward from [[Raffle of the Century]].

== Usage ==
'''Pandora's Box''' unlocks 20 Challenges, which can be completed while it is in the player's inventory or [[Accessory Bag]]. For every 2 challenges completed the player gets {{stat|hp|+1}} and {{stat|str|+1}}, up to {{Red|+10}} of each. Its rarity is not upgraded when [[Recombobulator 3000|Recombobulated]], and can only be increased by completing challenges.

== Notes ==
*If a '''Pandora's Box''' is traded to another player, it will keep its rarity. However, if they open it, it will gain or lose rarity based on the number of challenges they've done.
*The M7 challenges can be completed even if players leave, as long as there were 5 players with the respective class at the beginning of the dungeon.
*The Dragon Puncher challenge cannot be done with {{Item|Halberd of the Shredded}}, but can be done with {{Item|Flaming Flay}}.
*The Dungeoneer challenge considers the following as a teleportation ability: {{Item|Spirit Leap}}, {{Item|Hyperion}}'s Wither Impact ability, {{Item|Ender Pearl}}, and {{Item|Aspect of the End}}'s Instant Transmission. However, it does not count {{Item|Hyperion}}'s Wither Impact ability as a teleportation ability during the Floor 7 boss fight.
